simple.meaning: חֻפָּה (chuppâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a canopy.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 3 times across Psalms, Isaiah, Joel, beginning at Psalms 19:6. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֻפָּה (H2646).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: חֻפָּה (chuppâh) / H2646 is traced through Psalms 19:6, Isaiah 4:5, Joel 2:16 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H2646. chuppah I. חֻמָּה noun feminine canopy, chamber (as covering, enclosing ) — absolute ׳ח Isa 4:5 ; suffix תֻמָּתוֺ Psa 19:6 ; חֻמָּתָהּ Joel 2:16 ; — 1 canopy , ח ׳עלכֿלכּֿבוד Isa 4:5 over all glory a canopy (for protection). 2 chamber , of bridegroom Psa 19:6 (metaphor of sunrising); of bride Joel 2:16 (|| חֶדֶר of bridegroom).

occurrences.englishText: His going out is from the end of the heavens,
Yahweh will create over the whole habitation of Mount Zion and over her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night, for over all the glory will be a canopy.
